\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-001} & The contract concerns one observation at a time
and a nonpolarimetric total-intensity-equivalent transformed signal.  It does
not authorize a physical Stokes interpretation from a component token. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-002} & PTC and AST meanings, identities, validity facts,
causes, uncertainty, and immutable ancestry are producer-owned facts.  JINC
uses them without reconstructing or redefining them. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-003} & An admitted $\omega_i$ is finite and strictly
positive and comes from one exact PTC family/version that explicitly permits
SCI-JINC.  No registered family or realized payload is admitted or supplied by
this source packet. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-004} & Equations~\eqref{eq:fixed-state-response}--
\eqref{eq:general-covariance} are conditional identities only.  Their
assumptions are not inferred from units, names, or another consumer's
permission. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-005} & The analytic family and parameter meanings are
approved, but no TolTEC numerical realization of $s_a$, $a_a$, $b_a$, $c_a$,
$(r_{\max})_a$, target-WCS metric, pixel scale, or
\texttt{subpixel\_n} is scientifically admitted, supplied, or recommended by
this source packet. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-006} & Point-phase evaluation and fully populated square
support are the scientific operator.  The owner-approved upper-bin phase
lattice admits every positive $n_{\mathrm{sub}}$, retains the positive
midpoint for exact zero phase when $n_{\mathrm{sub}}$ is even, and retains
positive-axis half-pixel center ties.  Pixel-area integration, a zero-phase
special case, a circular cutoff, footprint-overlap admission, and
JINC-then-crop equivalence are not alternative branches. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-007} & Numerical-realization adequacy requires one exact
owner-approved $\mathcal{P}_{\mathrm{NA}}$ and a matching certificate
$\mathcal{E}_p$.  Neither is admitted or supplied by this source packet.
Finite arithmetic, analytic-function, phase/cache, and accumulation errors
therefore have no authorized approximate substitute, and numerical support is
typed unavailable even though exact-arithmetic algebraic support is defined.
A future passing profile/certificate pair establishes only finite-precision
fidelity to its exact selected discrete oracle; it does not qualify TolTEC
parameters, phase resolution, square truncation, response, performance,
validation, readiness, or production use. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-008} & Same-observation chunking may be an engineering
realization of one bundle, but a chunk is not a scientific product identity.
Cross-observation combination is outside base v0.1. \\
\texttt{SCI-JINC-ASM-009} & This Stage B draft has inspected no implementation
candidate, configuration, product, test, audit, validation, reduction, or
production evidence. \\
\bottomrule

Response, covariance, formal weight, physical exposure, cross-observation
coaddition, standalone support or availability, diagnostics, dense
per-contribution provenance, and generalized provenance products are deferred
or outside base v0.1, rather than silently missing members of the fixed
five-plane bundle.  The compact replay record $G_a$ is required bundle-level
information state, not an additional product role or generalized provenance
framework.
